full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 39
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Monday, Ashadh 22, 2083
11:00 AM
Management Work
On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balen Shah, Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam:
(a) Will present a proposal seeking leave to introduce the "Bill to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, 2083".
(b) Will present the "Bill to Revive the Previous Provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042, 2083".
2. Honourable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present a proposal that the "Nepal Rastra Bank (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083" be sent to the relevant committee for clause-wise discussion.
3. Honourable Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation Khadga Raj Poudel will present a proposal that the "Intangible Cultural Heritage (Conservation) Bill, 2083", originating from the National Assembly, be sent to the relevant committee for clause-wise discussion.
Discussion on Agreements
4. Honourable Minister for Youth, Labour and Employment Ramji Yadav:
(a) Will present a proposal for general discussion on "Protocol No. 29 of 2014 concerning the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 of the International Labour Organization".
(b) Will present a proposal for general discussion on "Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (No. 81) of the International Labour Organization".
Pada Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Management Work
sections.summary_en: The Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, on behalf of the Prime Minister, sought and received permission to introduce a bill to revive previous provisions of the Nepal Special Service Act, 2042. Subsequently, the Finance Minister proposed sending the Nepal Rastra Bank (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083 to committee, and the Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation proposed sending the Intangible Cultural Heritage (Conservation) Bill, 2083 to committee.
